description: This file defines the implementation of the InputMapper class, which manages input device interactions such as device info population, sensor control, stylus state updates, and key/button state queries within the Android input system.

classes.name: InputMapper
classes.description: A class responsible for mapping input device events and managing input device state within the Android input system.

methods.name: populateDeviceInfo
methods.description: Populates the InputDeviceInfo object with source information.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the internal state of the InputMapper for debugging.

methods.name: reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures the input mapper with new settings.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the input mapper state.

methods.name: timeoutExpired
methods.description: Handles timeout expiration events.

methods.name: getKeyCodeState
methods.description: Returns the current state of a key code.

methods.name: getScanCodeState
methods.description: Returns the current state of a scan code.

methods.name: getSwitchState
methods.description: Returns the current state of a switch.

methods.name: getKeyCodeForKeyLocation
methods.description: Returns the key code for a given key location.

methods.name: markSupportedKeyCodes
methods.description: Marks supported key codes.

methods.name: vibrate
methods.description: Starts vibration with a specified sequence.

methods.name: cancelVibrate
methods.description: Cancels ongoing vibration.

methods.name: isVibrating
methods.description: Checks if the device is currently vibrating.

methods.name: getVibratorIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of vibrators.

methods.name: cancelTouch
methods.description: Cancels ongoing touch events.

methods.name: enableSensor
methods.description: Enables a sensor with specified sampling parameters.

methods.name: disableSensor
methods.description: Disables a specified sensor.

methods.name: flushSensor
methods.description: Flushes sensor data.

methods.name: getMetaState
methods.description: Returns the current meta state.

methods.name: updateMetaState
methods.description: Updates the meta state based on a key code.

methods.name: updateExternalStylusState
methods.description: Updates the stylus state externally.

methods.name: getAbsoluteAxisInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about an absolute axis.

methods.name: bumpGeneration
methods.description: Increments the device generation count.

methods.name: dumpRawAbsoluteAxisInfo
methods.description: Outputs raw absolute axis info for debugging.

methods.name: dumpStylusState
methods.description: Outputs stylus state information for debugging.
